name: compound-interest-is-forever
why: Opens on a 272% bond popping the Fat Cat's pupils and buttons, escalates through a punch-card heart that jams on dying people and a trip into hell for a competitive rate, and pays off on a tear that lasts one second and a compound-interest line that never stops climbing.

name: less-likely-than-lightning
why: Six cents on one pan against a bus of money flings the coins into orbit and back onto YOU's head, then the odds chart shows saying no is 200 times less likely than lightning, and the lightning hits YOU.

name: the-nesting-doll-problem
why: A frame-tall doll of permits opens into smaller and smaller permits until the smallest holds the biggest and swallows YOU, the key waves from inside the locked room, and the SEC and the bank shake hands under a plaque reading ON PURPOSE.
